title: Property migration, assigned discrepancy review, rehearsals and editable receiving

task.name: Commission one selected property-continuity migration and assigned review through complete independent receiving
task.purpose: Give the customer's property, finance, document, spatial and implementation teams a complete retained explanation of what moved, which relationships and values agree, which observations remain unresolved, and what the named authority actually accepted. Carry the original files, exact mappings, complete reports, review decisions and editable history into the receiving team's own working directory. Give each assigned reviewer the full original finding, report context, exact-number locations and evidence in an editable offline copy; retain the returned advice and the supervisor's own adoption separately.
task.request: Continue the original customer Workshare and Customer installation. Select the actual authorized source and target platforms, complete cohort boundaries, identity namespaces, property hierarchy, rental-space and lease conventions, project references, controlled-document editions, finance amounts/currencies and spatial coordinate reference systems. Retain original extractions and independently acquired target returns. Review explicit typed mappings and relationships, inspect every source/target row and complete finding, and record the accountable review. Operate two distinct rehearsals against later source acquisitions, plan the authorized cutover and recovery procedure, then record its actual complete result or failed-load observation. Export the full case, independently receive it, continue a legitimate later edit and retain both original and received branches. Use the maintained property-continuity application, authenticated client and original SCF Installation; all platform execution follows the selected customer's own approved implementation. For assigned discrepancy review, issue the selected original finding IDs and complete source context to the named reviewer from the current physical workspace. Retain the exact issued JSON and self-contained HTML, receive the whole returned file even when it contains only unfinished work, and select an actual complete named edition for comparison. Review issued, current and proposed dispositions with the exact comparison SHA and workspace revision. Choose KEEP/CURRENT or APPLY/RETURNED for each assigned finding and use the original atomic adoption command with the supervisor's actor and time. Applying retains the selected returned disposition, reason and evidence. BLOCKING findings can require correction but cannot become accepted exceptions. Carry issued and returned originals, every named edition and attachment, the frozen comparison and choices into the full archive and reopen them in the receiving branch.
task.completeOutput: A complete original file/edition register; explicit reviewed mappings and source-to-target identities; full row accounting, typed comparisons and relationship findings for each selected reconciliation; retained review decisions and two rehearsal records; the named cutover plan, actual authority and result; complete reports and original-history workspace archives; an independently reopened editable receiving branch; the original Workshare and Installation with actual operator observations, source ownership, ongoing correction/support and recovery instructions. Include the exact issue JSON and original reviewer HTML; complete returned JSON/HTML and all source/evidence bytes; attributed named editions with their immutable hashes and parent history; retained unfinished drafts and both sides of any working-copy conflict; the complete issued/current/proposed comparison, explicit supervisor choices and original adoption result; and the same evidence/history reopened after onward receiving.
task.repeatTrigger: A source owner supplies a later extraction or target return, a load produces a new result, a reviewer changes a mapping or finding disposition, or the customer selects another explicitly complete cohort. Preserve earlier source editions, command requests, complete results and decisions. Reopening a report, continuing a saved request or receiving the same original archive continues that recorded operation. A new rehearsal or cutover selection uses the actual later acquisitions and its own original load identity. A later assigned review or a returned reviewer edition is retained under its original issue, return and edition identities. A repeated edition UUID retains the same complete canonical body; independently edited branches may be received as distinct returns without overwriting either. Following stages use their own frozen inputs under the original commissioning operation.
task.pricedUnit: The useful implementation workshare or expressly selected customer service unit in the original agreement. The original Bluewave planning offer is a proposed implementation programme with its own inventory assumptions and milestones; its amount is not a native token price or an accepted customer order. Preserve existing commercial prices, effort, dates and actual payment selections from the original Workshare.

source.reference: Complete original customer source exports, extraction metadata, reviewed platform/field contracts, independently acquired target returns, original load observations and actual review/recovery evidence. The maintained application includes the full public IDA request-to-participate text extraction as background source; it does not supply tenant data or determine a partner's current procurement appointment. Assigned review also retains complete original issue and return documents, original standalone editor source, named editions, actual attachment bytes and the frozen historical comparison.
source.population: Select a complete declared cohort for every source and target family, with platform, family, identity namespace, source reference, acquisition time, complete/partial declaration and original expected row count. Preserve all present rows, duplicates, invalid identities and incomplete coverage. Each file is at most 64 MiB, distinct retained source/evidence bytes 256 MiB, each dataset 25,000 rows and one reconciliation 100,000 total source plus target rows. Agree complete cohort boundaries before splitting a larger estate, including the full related-property coverage needed to assess hierarchy. One assigned issue and each complete return or self-contained HTML are limited to 64 MiB, with at most 1,000 selected findings and 1,000 named editions per return. Every named edition includes every issued finding exactly once; an unfinished draft is preserved separately. Evidence files count toward the same 256 MiB distinct workspace-byte limit. If a full HTML exceeds its whole-file limit, preserve the complete valid JSON and report the capacity boundary.
source.meaning: Keep exact source bytes and every original typed value. Identity keys explicitly combine the selected platform/family/namespace fields; related references declare their own actual target namespace. Preserve JSON number tokens without floating-point rounding and show their original JSON pointers. Money uses exact decimal text and a separately selected currency. A lease's LIVE/ACTIVE state and reviewed interval/end-boundary convention are explicit. Controlled documents retain actual version, hash and byte length; project KPN remains a separate identity. Spatial coordinates retain their declared CRS, units and source interpretation. Finance records preserve their original authoritative platform and sign convention. Reviewer recommendations use the original finding SHA and exact issued context. Named editions retain the assigned reviewer's complete identity, observed time, immediate parent, full items and canonical SHA. A decided item has a reason and complete evidence references; an undecided named item remains explicit. Returned advice, current native dispositions and historical adopted decisions are separate records.
source.changePolicy: Import a changed file or extraction as a new immutable edition. Save mapping corrections as new reviewed records and reconcile the selected complete inputs again. Keep the original reports and decisions as historical records. Incomplete or invalid key coverage remains UNVERIFIED rather than asserting that a missing target row was lost. The original source or target owner performs any tenant correction, actual migration load, financial posting, document signing or spatial edit through its established authorized process. Preserve both sides of a competing-tab or returned-file conflict before choosing a copy. A supervisor's permitted APPLY uses the original finding writer inside one workspace transaction. KEEP retains the native current decision. Neither offline advice nor its receipt changes a tenant, releases production, waives a BLOCKING finding or supplies customer acceptance.

receiving.application: The property-continuity application in the existing SCF Applications lifecycle, carrying the maintained Python application and current assigned-review successor under products/property-continuity/app/. Select the saved physical workspace directory, Python 3.11+ executable, private connection file and independent receiving directory. The authenticated client and agent methods address that same original service. Customer installations retains the complete implementation workorder and native commercial/operating history. Use the complete current app/source-selection.json and guides pinned below; earlier selected source and completed results remain their historical editions. The optional reviewer browser course uses stable Playwright 1.55 or newer, verifies the actual installed package before launch and borrows the original browser owner's one Chrome process.
receiving.acceptanceRule: Open and visibly inspect the exact installed application at the actual screenshare width and 390 px where relevant. Operate the important source, mapping, report, decision, export and reopen controls on the selected authorized case. Confirm both-side row accounting, exact numeric/financial semantics, all required relationships and every unresolved finding. Accepted rehearsals use their actual later acquisitions and independent target returns. Cutover authority precedes the actual load inside its selected window; a failed or incomplete cutover retains its actual observations and reason. Receive the complete archive into a separate directory, verify its original full history/reports/source, perform an actual permitted later edit, reopen it and export its continuation. Record actual customer acceptance and operator observations in the original Installation. Operate Assigned reviews through issue, unfinished offline save/reopen, complete named editions, an actual source/evidence attachment, explicit return receipt, comparison and KEEP/APPLY adoption. Inspect both sides of a real same-copy competing-tab conflict and the independently retained working copy. Reopen the original frozen comparison read-only after adoption and after full archive receiving; a current comparison remains a separate live view. Inspect desktop and narrow screens, actual screenshots and every outgoing JSON, HTML and whole archive. The owner opens, looks at and uses the rendered product and fixes concrete issues within the same operation before recording observed acceptance.
receiving.changeAndWithdraw: Customer data ownership, supplier licensing, source-use permission, tenant credentials, platform administration and production release decisions remain with the named actual owners. The local workspace retains authorized evidence and reviewer decisions. Record access withdrawal and retention/deletion decisions through those existing controls, including all independently received copies. Keep portable archives and the private capability-bearing connection file in their selected authorized locations.
receiving.recovery: Keep original workspace UUID and physical directory together. Resolve an interrupted command from its saved request UUID and original first result before another mutation. A definite revision conflict is resolved against the current saved edition while preserving the unsent draft. Preserve original and received branches independently even when they share a portable workspace UUID. Reuse the original archive hash, bytes, receiving operation and destination for a known interrupted receive; a repeated receive must preserve a receiver's legitimate later edits. Continue Start/Stop or managed-run recovery through the same Applications operation. Inspect and reconcile an existing live workspace owner before another server launch. Retain original issued bytes, working-copy UUID, named-edition UUID/parent/hash, return ID, comparison SHA, physical workspace and original request ID across retries. Download complete in-memory recovery candidates when browser persistence is unavailable. On a stale native comparison, preserve the previous review and review the new current comparison before another deliberate adoption. The optional staged receiving command uses the existing operation lock and frozen ISSUE/BROWSER/RECEIVE/COMPARE/ADOPT/ONWARD inputs. Preserve a CLOSURE_PENDING browser owner and inherited lock until its actual shutdown is reconciled.
receiving.maintenance: Name the source/target owners, mapping and finance/document/spatial reviewers, original load writer, release authority, receiving operator and ongoing support engineer. Retain source schedules, cohort and schema-change review, workspace/source backups, private connection renewal, restore/rollback procedure, full report locations and original commercial correction/support allowance. Distinguish local software training from actual tenant commissioning. Keep the original complete release and its operating, data-contract, training and receiving guides available with each handover. Name the assigned reviewer and adopting supervisor separately. Retain every issued/returned file and historical decision after reviewer reassignment or later corrections. Keep the complete current domain, offline editor, staff/SDK and staged receiving guides with the original Installation's source attachments.

steps.title: Continue the original Workshare and Installation
steps.result: Open the existing customer case and commercial plan. Preserve all original phases, fees, actual effort sources, funded assignments and acceptance criteria. Prepare a fresh PLANNED Installation seed only when no operated Installation exists; otherwise update the existing native edition.

steps.title: Select deployment, owners and complete cohorts
steps.result: Record the actual source and target platforms, responsible team, complete row populations, original system namespaces, extraction rights, receiving host and working directories. Select the platform/field contracts and all related entity coverage before authoring mappings.

steps.title: Install and open the original application
steps.result: Receive the complete selected SCF release. Select property-continuity in Applications, review the existing workspace, Python executable, connection and receiving paths, save the application and use its ordinary Review Start/Start/Open lifecycle. Confirm the exact title, portable identity, physical branch and saved revision.

steps.title: Retain full source and independent target editions
steps.result: Import the original source/evidence bytes and every required family with actual acquisition metadata, expected and observed row counts, format and complete/partial scope. Keep target returns tied to the actual completed load and their own later extraction, even if their values happen to match the source.

steps.title: Review mappings and cross-system meaning
steps.result: Select actual source/target columns, exact typed comparisons, identity and relationship namespaces, lease status/interval rules, document version/hash/size, project identity, finance signs/currencies and spatial CRS/units. Save and review the complete mapping with named operator and evidence.

steps.title: Reconcile and inspect the whole selected cohort
steps.result: Run against the selected actual source/target editions and original load. Inspect complete row groups, duplicates, missing/extra/UNVERIFIED classifications, field differences and related-entity findings. Inspect original numeric tokens and exact finance arithmetic. Download the complete report rather than relying on one visible page.

steps.title: Issue the complete assigned discrepancy review
steps.result: In Assigned reviews, select the actual reconciliation and every intended finding, the named reviewer and assignment note. Inspect the complete source/target rows, number-token locations, mapping approvals and prior decisions. Prepare and issue the full reviewer JSON and standalone HTML through the original saved-request and workspace-revision flow; retain both original files and the selected issue identity.

steps.title: Operate the offline reviewer copy and retain complete editions
steps.result: Open the exact issued HTML, inspect full finding context and download original source/evidence bytes. Retain unfinished drafts without inventing a complete decision. Save attributed complete editions covering every assigned finding, attach actual evidence and preserve every parent/hash. REQUIRE_CORRECTION is available for BLOCKING findings; ACCEPT_EXCEPTION is allowed only for REVIEW findings. Preserve both competing-tab versions and an explicitly separate working copy, then export and independently reopen complete JSON/HTML.

steps.title: Receive the original return and compare current decisions
steps.result: Inspect and retain the entire returned file and its exact issued binding. A zero-edition unfinished return can be kept as evidence; comparison selects an actual named edition. Review all issued/current/proposed items, exact evidence bytes and any stale baseline against the native comparison SHA and workspace revision. Preserve the prior complete return and earlier comparison when a newer edition or workspace change arrives.

steps.title: Adopt explicit supervisor choices and reopen the frozen review
steps.result: For each assigned finding choose KEEP/CURRENT or APPLY/RETURNED against the exact return, edition, comparison and current revision. The original atomic native command records the supervisor's actor and time, applies the selected returned disposition, reason and evidence through the original finding writer, and retains the complete review basis. Reopen that frozen comparison read-only with the actual saved choices; later current dispositions remain visible separately. Returned advice alone never authorizes cutover or a tenant change.

steps.title: Record decisions and the first rehearsal
steps.result: The accountable reviewer selects REQUIRE_CORRECTION or an explicitly justified ACCEPT_EXCEPTION on each finding. Keep original decision evidence. Record the actual accepted or rejected first rehearsal against that reconciliation and its retained load/source basis.

steps.title: Operate the later second rehearsal
steps.result: Receive genuinely later source and target acquisitions from a separate actual load of the same reviewed cohort and mapping lineage. Reconcile and resolve its own findings. Record the second rehearsal with the accepted first rehearsal reference and the full original evidence.

steps.title: Prepare the production window and recovery
steps.result: Select both accepted rehearsals, current approved mapping/finding basis, named authority, cutoff and start/end window. Retain actual delta-capture, rollback, restore and recovery-readiness procedures. Record the release authority through its original reviewed decision.

steps.title: Record the actual cutover outcome
steps.result: Retain the actual load and independently acquired final return, then reconcile the complete selected cohort. For acceptance, verify its complete source, mapping and decision basis and actual load chronology. For rejection, record the true incomplete/failed/unknown load observation and reason, including absent start/completion or final return where applicable.

steps.title: Export, independently receive and continue
steps.result: Export the selected saved revision with every original command, first result, retained source, report and application file. Receive it into a separate working directory, inspect its full history and reports, perform an actual permitted later edit, reopen that branch and export its continuation. Keep the original branch available.

steps.title: Complete native Installation return and support
steps.result: Attach the actual original and receiving outputs to the existing Installation. Record observed acceptance, each continuing owner and the agreed support/change procedure. Export and independently reopen the complete SCF case through the maintained Operations importer. The original funding plan and company relationship retain their existing custody.

inputs: Complete original customer Workshare, canonical commercial plan, every phase and effort source, current original Installation or fresh PLANNED seed, and the named customer/implementation owners.
Actual selected deployment, full original source/target platform and field contracts, permitted extraction scope, production/load authority and original evidence-use rights.

Full source and independent target files with original SHA256/bytes, extraction reference and time, family/platform/identity namespace, expected row count, completeness and complete cohort boundaries.
Explicit cross-system identity keys and relationship namespaces for property, rental space, lease, project, controlled documents, finance and spatial records.

Reviewed field types and exact value conventions, including JSON numeric tokens, decimal-text money/currency, lease LIVE/ACTIVE interval/end semantics, controlled-document version/hash/size and spatial CRS/units.
Actual original load UUID/input digest, writer, start/completion, outcome and retained evidence for each rehearsal or production run; independent target-extraction observations.
Named mapping and finding reviewers, complete decisions and reasons, original authority/evidence and the selected current review basis.
Two actual rehearsal reports and their independent later acquisitions, complete production cutoff/window, delta verification and actual rollback/recovery readiness.
Existing retained workspace UUID plus canonical physical directory, complete selected application/runtime, Python 3.11+, private connection path and distinct receiving destination.
Original source/workspace archives, complete report/download set, named receiving engineer, actual reopen/edit observations and later receiving export.
Actual customer-specific payment/deployment selections only when applicable; retain native atomic units and authorization separately from implementation fees and grant funding.
Selected ongoing source cadence, schema/cohort-change policy, data retention/withdrawal ownership, backups/restoration and original commercial correction/support terms.

Actual selected reconciliation/finding IDs, named assigned reviewer and supervisor, current physical workspace revision/state SHA, assignment note and full issued JSON/HTML including every original source/context/evidence file.

Complete returned JSON or HTML with exact issued bytes, working-copy identity, every retained named-edition body/hash/parent and unfinished draft; actual attachment descriptors and bytes, including any independently retained conflict copy.

Explicit selected returnId and editionId, original comparison SHA and current workspace revision, a deliberate KEEP/APPLY choice for every assigned finding, supervisor actor/time, selected returned reason/evidence and the original native request UUID.

Complete current application source selection and reviewer guides; actual stable Playwright 1.55+ package, existing browser owner and isolated receiving host for the optional staged browser course; two explicit complete reviewer editions and a real attachment selected by the operator.

Original commissioning operation/input/directory and same operation lock, frozen following-stage inputs, complete stage outputs and original/onward archives, actual desktop/narrow screenshots and recorded owner inspection of every outgoing file.
